name: print-social-bronze-digital-marketing-agency-post-with-3d-social-bubbles
title: Bronze 'We Are Digital Marketing Agency' post with 3D notification bubbles around a woman on a tablet
whatItIs: A square post with a bronze-tinted office photo on top, a script 'We Are' over bold white 'Digital Marketing Agency', a rounded photo of a woman using a tablet surrounded by 3D cart, heart, bell and emoji bubbles, a 'What we do' list, a bronze 'Join now' button and contact details.
whatItMeans: Polished and social-savvy; floating notification bubbles show the results of good marketing.
techniques: Float 3D social notification icons around the subject.
Tint the top photo in the brand colour.
Split into a photo top and white info bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A speech-bubble icon like a phone alert.
A photo coloured with one brand hue.
